claim: Gross margin was above 35% in every month of 2026-H1.

bundle.metric_definition: gross_margin = (revenue - cogs) / revenue, where revenue = sum(amount) for account 'revenue' and cogs = sum(amount) for account 'cogs', rows dated within the period
bundle.notes: Export range: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31. General-ledger export from the ERP.
